steps.caption: Open Leases from the sidebar, under Work.
The tabs: Leases (this dashboard), Calendar, Renewals, Obligations, Portfolio and Radar — the old lease radar now lives here.
The headline counts: active leases, expiries in the next 12 months, renewal deadlines, escalations, lock-in completions, break options and pending obligations.
They count only confirmed dates. Dates awaiting review are counted separately because they are not yet contractual deadlines.
Filter by lifecycle status: draft, under negotiation, executed, active, renewal under discussion, termination notice served, expired and more.
Filter by category: conventional office, managed office, coworking, retail or industrial.
Filter by event type and time window — for example lock-in completions in the next 90 days.
Upcoming milestones lists each confirmed date with the lease and how many days are left.
Widen the window to the next 365 days and clear the event filter to see everything coming up.
The milestones now include expiries and renewal notice deadlines for the demo leases.
Below is every lease: tenant, property, category, status and what it still Needs — for example rent or a confirmed expiry.
Search finds a lease by tenant, landlord or building.
Filter, then open the lease to see its details.
The lease page: overview, important dates, terms, financials, documents, obligations, renewal, termination, reminders and history.
